primary_eligible_domain: OCCLUDED_AGREEMENT target frames in SHORT through NEAR_CONTEXT; BEYOND_CONTEXT is required characterization but outside the continuation-gate aggregate

for_each_heldout_trajectory_t.E_t: all frozen eligible primary rows in SHORT through NEAR_CONTEXT
for_each_heldout_trajectory_t.ybar_t: arithmetic mean of true world-x over E_t

primary_metric.macro_R2: unweighted arithmetic mean of R2_t across the 25 out-of-fold heldout trajectories
primary_metric.trajectory_weight: exactly equal; frame count cannot alter weight
primary_metric.zero_TSS_policy: BLOCK_FIRST_SLICE_ADJUDICATION; never drop or pool trajectory
primary_metric.pooled_frame_R2_role: secondary reporting only; cannot rescue gate

natural_unit_secondary_metrics.primary_target: per-trajectory MAE in blocks followed by unweighted trajectory mean; also median absolute error in blocks
natural_unit_secondary_metrics.secondary_target: Euclidean error in continuous token-cell units plus row/column MAE

kinematic_baselines.LAST_VISIBLE_POSITION: carry forward the last VISIBLE_AGREEMENT world-x before the entry transition
kinematic_baselines.CONSTANT_VELOCITY_EXTRAPOLATION: causal least-squares world-x versus time fit on the last up-to-E=15 VISIBLE_AGREEMENT frames before transition; extrapolate without hidden targets
kinematic_baselines.TRAINING_MEAN: outer-training-only mean world-x stratified by direction and duration bin; no heldout statistic

bootstrap.seed_derivation: SHA256 of frozen A3 manifest hash and literal REGIME_A_BOOTSTRAP_V1

continuation_gate.domain: aggregate SHORT through NEAR_CONTEXT exactly as primary_metric.E_t
